dedupe_keys.name: morocco lists of public school establishments by cycle ministry of national education data gov ma

description: This dataset on Morocco's national open data portal gives the lists of public school establishments by cycle, published by the Ministry of National Education: one spreadsheet for primary schools, one for lower secondary (collégial) and one for upper secondary (qualifiant) schools. The primary schools sheet holds 7,574 establishments, each with its name and address in French and in Arabic, a telephone number, the province and the region. Coverage: public schools in all provinces of Morocco, grouped under the regional division in force before 2015. Access: three XLS files on data.gov.ma with the CKAN API; the dataset was created in 2014 and its entry last modified on 13 December 2021, and a separate entry on the portal holds an April 2011 list of public schools with fax and email. Licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL); free. Caveats: the files date from 2014 and have not been refreshed, so openings, closures and the 2015 regional reform are not reflected; there are no coordinates, so mapping needs geocoding of addresses; private schools are in another entry. Simulation uses are a baseline inventory of schools as critical facilities and shelters for exposure and emergency planning studies in Morocco, for example for earthquake scenarios. Related records: the Argentina register of educational establishments; the Philippines public school locations.
